subject: Opalix Therapeutics - collectability risk & credit committee ask
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Opalix Therapeutics - outstanding invoices & collectability risk

Team,

Quick summary — Opalix (SMB therapeutics customer) is 78 days past due on a $300k AR balance (two invoices: INV-2026-411 / INV-2026-433). I've attached the aged balance and copies of the invoices (see attachment: aged_balance_opalix.xlsx). Collections outreach has been met with promises but no remittance to date.

Why I’m escalating:
- Cash at risk: $300k aged >60 days, payment promises slipped twice.
- Product risk: they are in the middle of a proof-of-concept; continued access increases our exposure.
- Reputational: they raised a funding round delay that they say impacted AP.

Suggested immediate actions (options for committee):
1) Credit committee: Accept a structured payment plan (partial now + installments) and require an autopay/ACH mandate + DocuSign SOW amendment to pause auto-invoicing for any new spend.
2) If committee declines: place account on credit hold and schedule a reseller interruption (last resort).

Please advise — we need a decision to present to their CFO this week. My recommendation is to accept a conditional payment plan (40% within 5 business days) with a hard trigger to suspend product access if a milestone is missed.

Attachments: aged_balance_opalix.xlsx

Thanks,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Account Exec, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Opalix Therapeutics - outstanding invoices & collectability risk

Thanks for the flag, Sergio — reading the aged. A couple quick thoughts:

- Customer tone has been apologetic in the last two threads; they’re candid about a VC wire delay.
- I agree with a conditional plan vs. immediate blackout — we should prioritize recovery and preserve the relationship if we can get an enforceable plan.

Proposed play:
1) Offer a payment plan: 40% now (clear in 5 bd), remaining $180k over 3 monthly installments.
2) Require an autopay mandate and signed DocuSign payment schedule.
3) Set net-30 on future invoices for the next 6 months and suspend any new invoicing (hold on consumption billing) until plan is complete.
4) Collections to run ACH verification and set trigger: missed installment -> 24-hour grace -> product suspension.

If finance signs off, I’ll take point on the customer call and ask for the AP contact + authorized signatory on the DocuSign.

From: Beth Hayes <beth.hayes@opalix.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts.payable <accounts.payable@opalix.com>, procurement <procurement@opalix.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 15:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Outstanding invoices - Opalix Therapeutics

Sergio —

Apologies for the delay and the back-and-forth. Short version: our Series B wire was delayed by 2 weeks; AP is understaffed while we reconcile investor debits. We value the partnership and do not intend to avoid payment.

Proposed plan (internal approval attached):
- Initial remittance: $120,000 within 5 business days from today.
- Remaining balance ($180,000) spread across three equal monthly payments starting 09/30/2026.
- We will sign a DocuSign payment schedule and provide an ACH mandate.

We request that Redwood maintain service access through the collection window (we are mid-PoC). If this is unacceptable, please let me know what alternative you require.

Attaching: opalix_payment_offer_signed.pdf

Best,
Beth Hayes
CFO, Opalix Therapeutics
beth.hayes@opalix.com
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Credit Committee <credit.committee@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Opalix payment offer — recommendation and approval request

Forwarding Opalix's signed offer. Recommendation below for committee decision:

Context: $300k outstanding; customer proposes $120k now + $60k x3 monthly. Proof: attached signed PDF from CFO and flagged HubSpot deal OPX-2026-137.

Recommendation (pick one):
A) APPROVE: Accept the plan with immediate 40% remittance, require ACH mandate, require DocuSign SOW amendment that includes autopay and a clearely defined service suspension trigger. Collections to monitor and confirm receipt of first remittance before 5bd.
B) CONDITIONAL: Approve but require a corporate guarantor or purchase order confirmation from parent entity before accepting terms.
C) DECLINE: Place account on credit hold, escalate to legal for recovery.

I recommend option A with a 5bd deadline for initial remittance. If the initial payment is not received we invoke the suspension trigger.

Attachments: payment_plan_summary.docx
Related Link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/OPX-2026-137

Thanks — need a committee decision by COB Mon 08/30.

Sergio
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Opalix payment offer — recommendation and approval request

Approved conditionally. Finance view: we will accept the proposed schedule with the following hard conditions — all must be met before we release any further credit:

1) Initial remittance of $120,000 must be received and cleared within 5 business days of today (by 09/06/2026).
2) Signed DocuSign payment schedule and ACH mandate on file (no exceptions).
3) Autopay requirement for the installment schedule and card/ACH authorization for fallback.
4) Collections to set up a monitoring cadence (Logan) and trigger immediate suspension of product access if any installment misses by >3 business days after a 24-hour reminder.

We will not require a parent guarantor at this time but will revisit if an installment is missed. If all conditions are satisfied Finance will mark the account as "on plan" and resume normal recognition.

Please confirm when you have the DocuSign link and when the initial remittance is posted.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Finance
Redwood Inference
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Beth Hayes <beth.hayes@opalix.com>, accounts.payable <accounts.payable@opalix.com>, procurement <procurement@opalix.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 17:00:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Outstanding invoices - Opalix Therapeutics — conditional acceptance

Beth — thanks for the offer and the signed doc. Finance has conditionally approved the plan with the requirements listed below. Summary of next steps: 

1) Please remit $120,000 to the account specified in the attached aged balance within 5 business days (by 09/06/2026).
2) Sign the DocuSign payment schedule (link: https://docusign.com/link/OPX-2026-137-plan) and provide ACH mandate.
3) If the initial remittance clears we will keep services active for the duration of the payment schedule. Missed installments will trigger the suspension process described by Markus (24-hour reminder, then suspend on day 3).

I’ve attached the dunning schedule we’ll use to track installments (dunning_schedule_opalix.csv).

Please confirm receipt of this email and when the initial payment is sent so Collections can monitor for clearance.

Best,
Sergio
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
